biography.bio:
A soft-spoken ecologist from Quebec whose mask lets him vanish into the scenery.

Masks: Maraj, New Maraj (wearing Maraj).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.fglboCC8yXALMDjq]{Detonator}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.ott2kIBLcOEYuwDm]{Detonator Quad}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.PI1qllApw1fwmxpi]{Glider Strike}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.DCgFWtq2Nz9EEHUU]{Volcano}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Bends light around the wearer - an invisibility screen.

Jacques LaFleur's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Invisibility Screen (a Move action): the wearer is Invisible until the end of their next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
A wig, a uniform and a new walk, and nobody looks twice. Without a mask on, your Deception and Infiltration Tests have Edge - a M.A.S.K. helmet is not much of a disguise.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: while you wear no mask, Deception and Infiltration Tests have Edge.

system.description:
The upgraded Maraj: invisibility, plus a holographic double to leave behind.

Jacques LaFleur's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Invisible until the end of the wearer's next turn. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
You and your mask are one. Rolls made with your mask's power are upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: an attack from one of your mask's Use buttons is upshifted once.
